Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I3, which must be 
 performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above titled block.
This compressor serves is compressing air for self-cleaning system which is 
 using to clean the Gas Turbine air filters and to control opening and closing 
 of inlet damper.
